positions.title: Consultant, Software Engineer II
positions.description: I’m a full-stack Software Engineer and Consultant supporting pharmacy automation applications at Cigna Healthcare, delivering reliable solutions for complex, business-critical healthcare workflows. I specialize in building scalable enterprise applications and RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework, .NET Core, Oracle SQL/PL/SQL, Angular, and React. Experienced across the full SDLC within Agile/Scrum environments, I focus on performance optimization, clean architecture, automated testing, and CI/CD with Azure DevOps. I also leverage generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor AI to accelerate development, debugging, code reviews, and documentation.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Create new and improve existing application functionalities based on customer requests as a C#/.NET back-end developer 
Use Jenkins for continuous integration practice, continuous code deployment (CI/CD), and version control 
Develop and maintain PowerShell/Bash scripts
Use the Unified Functional Testing (UFT) automation testing tool to create scripts running on VBScript to automate use cases for functional and regression testing 
Maintain and create new automated test code to perform API integration testing
Perform end-to-end automated testing using test plans to quickly compare output with requirements

positions.title: Software Configuration Intern
positions.description:
Manage and configure the IPad and Web application using JSON files.
Create SQL queries to make summaries from reports created in the app.
Project and task tracking with the use of an Agile software.
Testing and debugging code with the use of Swift++ in Xcode.
Complete and track tasks as a team member with the use of an Agile software.

positions.title: Net Suite Subject Matter Expert
positions.description:
Train new employees how to successfully manage and resolve any issues with the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Software. 
Report any bugs and difficulties with the CRM.  
Received intensive training to perfectly utilize the CRM software. 
Able to provide support to other employees with any arising issues with the software.
